purpose: Confirm the Phase 2 contact-cue trend at q_held=0.6 with fresh seeds; Phase 2 seeds are not pooled.

data.frames_and_embeddings: Phase 2 caches unchanged (90,240 train frames, 816 probes); no rendering or embedding

fixed_settings.training: nursery/cue_learning/config.json unchanged: 20 epochs, batch 256, lr 0.0003, window 2, min_freq 5

primary_metric: test-probe 4AFC accuracy at dev-selected epoch, percent
analysis: Paired by seed; mean difference and 95% Student t interval, df=24.

decision_rule.confirmed: all three interval lower bounds > 0 (the Phase 2 positive criterion)
decision_rule.timing_only: contact - shuffled and contact - shifted lower bounds > 0, contact - none not

exclusions: None. Every run must finish; a crashed run is rerun once with the identical command and reported. No run is selected, excluded or rerun on accuracy.
